startPages.label: Start page per role
startPages.help: The section each role opens on after sign-in. A role that is not listed, or cannot open its section, starts on the Dashboard.

shell.label: Menu badges and search
shell.help: How many seconds the waiting-work numbers on the menu are kept before they are counted again, how many results search shows per group, and from how many letters it looks for products, orders and customers. Also: how many of the pages a person opened last the empty search lists for them (0 = none, as it ships), and whether "g" then a letter opens a section, such as g d for the Dashboard and g o for Orders (off as it ships).

dashboard.label: Dashboard date choices and greeting
dashboard.help: The date choices above the money tiles in days (1 = today; the first one opens) and the hours the greeting changes to afternoon and evening, and how many days the small line in each money tile shows.
